newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan raises '97 estimate on 6 steel firms.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan raises '97 estimate on 6 steel firms.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan steel analyst Mike Gambardella said he raised his full-year '97 estimate on AK Steel Holding Corp, Bethlehem Steel Corp, Inland Steel Industries Inc, LTV Corp, National Steel Corp, and USX-U.S. Steel Group.

-- AK was raised to $4.40 from $3.80; Bethlehem was raised to $0.50 from ($1.00); Inland was raised to $0.95 from $0.25; LTV was raised to $0.80 from ($0.25); National was raised to $0.60 from ($2.29); and U.S. Steel was raised to $2.85 from $0.40.
-- Gambardella said he raised the estimates because downward pressure on steel prices will be delayed in 1997 due to the ongoing strike at WHX Corp.
-- "We are pushing out our forecast for the beginning of sheet price weakness from the second to the third quarter in 1997, mainly owing to the lengthy WHX strike," Gambardella said.
-- Gambardella said he expects supply increases from imports and new capacity to put downward pressure on prices in the second half of the year.
